message.content:
A magazine cover for "TEMPO" features a caricature of a man depicted as a scarecrow standing in a golden-yellow field. The figure wears a tall, frayed straw hat, glasses, and a goatee. He is dressed in a light-colored, long-sleeved shirt and tattered brown overalls. Numerous green banknotes are stuck all over his clothes, hat, and arms. His arms are outstretched and attached to a horizontal wooden pole, with two human hands visible on the left side holding one end of the pole. Additional banknotes flutter in the air around the figure.

Large red text at the top reads "TEMPO" with "ENAK DIBACA DAN" below it. Headlines at the very top include "Tipu-tipu Laporan Keuangan BUMN Karya H.84" and "Nyanyian Patgulipat Nasabah Mayapada H.74". Central white text reads "BUKAN SEKADAR UPETI MENTERI," followed by a paragraph mentioning "Syahrul Yasin Limpo." The bottom left includes a date "19-25 JUNI 2023," a price, a barcode, and a QR code. The background shows a soft-focus landscape of yellow crops under a hazy green and yellow sky.
